description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget called BoardTile, representing an animated, interactive tile used on a Tic Tac Toe game board. It handles visual states like highlighting, tap feedback animations, and displays X or O symbols with appropriate styling.

classes.name: BoardTile
classes.description: A stateful widget representing a clickable, animated tile on the Tic Tac Toe board, showing X or O, with visual feedback and highlighting.

classes.name: _BoardTileState
classes.description: The internal state class managing animations, tap interactions, and visual updates for the BoardTile widget.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the BoardTile widget.

methods.description: Initializes the animation controller and animation for tap feedback.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the animation controller to free resources.

methods.name: _handleTapDown
methods.description: Handles visual feedback when the tile is pressed down.

methods.name: _handleTapCancel
methods.description: Reverses animation if the tap is canceled.

methods.name: _handleTapUp
methods.description: Reverses animation when the tap is released.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the animated interactive tile, adding gesture detection and styling based on the current state.
